meta.title: Fold Minimal
meta.description: When the sidebar is collapsed, keeps a toolbar at the window's top-left — reopen / global panel icons in the same order as the sidebar menu / new session / back to session. v0.6 detects the DSH version: on the new release it follows the official pinned menu (pinned panels appear in the toolbar and sidebar; unpinned panels stay in the official More menu). Dragging in the collapsed toolbar expands it and follows one ghost icon; crossing the pin boundary pins or unpins through the official state, and the plugin keeps no second hidden state. Rows in both the official More menu and the collapsed More menu can be dragged from anywhere. The old release keeps the plugin's own fold and More tray. The plugin page offers three independent switches — Collapsed menu / Back-to-session button / Panel reorder & fold.
